newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU opens probe into Coca-Cola UK buy.
newsitem.headline: EU opens probe into Coca-Cola UK buy.

text.p: The European Commission said on Friday it was opening an in-depth probe under the European Union's merger regulation into the purchase by Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc. of Amalgamated Beverages Great Britain Limited.
Amalgamated owns British bottler Coca-Cola & Schweppes Beverages Limited (CCSB).
"The Commission's investigation will examine the impact of the proposed acquisition on the conditions of competition for soft drinks in Great Britain," the Commission said in a statement.
It gave no details of why it was opening the second stage of a probe, a move that usually means the Commission has some concerns about the impact of the deal on competition in the European Union.
Under the deal Coca-Cola Enterprises would take over CCSB, which bottles distributes and markets beverages in Britain, primarily Coca-Cola and Cadbury Schweppes brands.
Both drinks companies would continue to own and promote their own brands, but Cadbury Schweppes would leave the bottling and distribution business in Britain, the Commission said.
The Commission opened the first stage of the probe in August. It now has four months to decide whether to clear the deal.
